case_number: 2025 INSC 114; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 355 OF 2013; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 788 OF 2013

parties.petitioner: Constable 907 Surendra Singh & Anr.; Ashad Singh Negi

summary: Appeal against High Court's reversal of acquittal; scope of interference in acquittal appeals; common intention under Section 34 IPC requires proof beyond reasonable doubt; trial court's acquittal based on lack of evidence against appellants; High Court's reappreciation deemed unwarranted; reliance on Gadadhar Chandra precedent; Babu Sahebagouda Rudragoudar principles applied; appellants' conviction set aside.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment reversed; acquittal of appellants restored.
